text:
Emily F: Heads up - noticed consistent APAC nightly GPU burn between 00:00-06:00 UTC over the last 7 days, ~2.1k GPU-hours/day, mostly tagged to dev-experiments and ml-sandbox. Cost spike hitting budgets for training teams.

Raj P: Ugh, saw that too. Any idea which projects are the heavy hitters?

Emily F: Quick breakdown from billing pipeline (sample):
```
project,avg_gpu_hours
dev-experiments,980
ml-sandbox,610
training-main,420
research-protos,110
```
Looks like dev-experiments + ml-sandbox ~75% of that window.

Priya S: Are these preemptible/spot VMs? That could explain weird nightly patterns.

billing-bot: automated-alert: nightly_gpu_burn > threshold (2000 hours) for finance/accounting on 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21 :eyes:

Emily F: Mostly spot instances per infra tags, but reserved and committed-usage covers part of it. The problem: chargeback rules currently assign reserved amortization by project tag at invoice time - which inflates dev-experiments budget and leaves training teams short.

Ava L: Proposal: smooth reserved amortization across a configurable window (shift 40% of reserved credit attribution from dev-experiments to training-main between 00:00-06:00 APAC window). That would better reflect who benefits from the reserved capacity.

Jake R: How would we implement? Change cost allocation service rule? Need approval from infra and product teams.

Priya S: Implementation idea: add a time-window rule to the allocation engine that looks at tag + window + project-weight override. e.g. config snippet:
```
allocation_rules:
  - window: "00:00-06:00"
    region: "apac"
    redistribute_reserved_from: [dev-experiments, ml-sandbox]
    redistribute_to: [training-main]
    weights: [0.4, 0.35, 0.25]
```
That keeps totals balanced but shifts cost smell away from training teams.

Emily F: I ran a simulation with last week's usage. Net impact: dev-experiments billed reserved amortization drops by ~35%, training-main increases by ~30%, overall invoice unchanged. Gives training teams breathing room for their monthly budget alerts.

Raj P: Who signs off? This affects internal chargebacks and team SLAs. We should get ProductOps and Platform Eng signoff. Also need one-off note in next invoice memo.

Ava L: I'll take Platform Eng approval. @Priya S can you draft the config PR and simulation results? Keep it small scope, toggleable feature flag for 2-week canary.

Priya S: Will do. Will include: 1) config diff, 2) simulation CSV, 3) rollback plan. Target PR by EOD tomorrow.

Jake R: Finance approves experimental canary for 14 days provided: (a) feature flag, (b) daily delta report to finance, (c) auto-rollback if training-main > budget threshold for 3 consecutive days.

Emily F: Agreed. Also add a line to the internal invoice that says "apac nightly amortization canary" so teams understand the temporary reallocation.

billing-bot: reminder: submit change request form for allocation-rule updates: https://internal.redwood/billing/change-requests

Raj P: Ok - next steps: Priya PR + simulation, Ava to confirm infra feasibility, Emily will notify impacted team leads (training, dev-experiments).

Emily F: Tagging people for visibility: @Raj P @Ava L @Priya S @Jake R - I'll ping team leads after PR lands.

Ava L: :thumbsup:

Priya S: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/merge/3456 - includes simulation CSV and test harness.

Emily F: Received. Monitoring plan?

Jake R: Finance will subscribe to the daily delta report + set an alert if dev-experiments drop below 50% of historical amortization unexpectedly.

Emily F: Great. We'll run the 14-day canary starting next Monday 00:00 UTC if no objections.

Raj P: No objections from finance side. Thanks everyone.

Ava L: I'll stand up infra canary config and notify oncall.

Emily F: Closing loop - will post a summary after day 1 of canary.

billing-bot: automated-note: allocation-change-ticket created #AC-8731
